caption: Quegourdes de turquie (left), Quegourdes (centre) and Concombres (right). Paintings from the Grandes Heures d'Anne de Bretagne (1503–1508). Rpt. Harry S. Paris, et al. “First Known Image of Cucurbita in Europe, 1503-1508.” Annals of Botany 98.1 (July 2006): 41-47.
alt: Three painted borders from a French book of hours, each a climbing vine on a gold ground: bottle gourds with orange flowers, a pale gourd with a white flower, and cucumbers with yellow flowers, among snails, butterflies and insects.
bibliography: Quegourdes de Turquie, Quegourdes and Concombres. Grandes Heures d’Anne de Bretagne, 1503–1508. Reproduced in Harry S. Paris et al., "First Known Image of Cucurbita in Europe, 1503–1508," Annals of Botany, vol. 98, no. 1, July 2006, pp. 41–47.
